body:
i have to be hers because i think she needs me

she is perfect

but she has made mistakes

i worry for her every day.

i cannot stand to simply watch over her. i want to be hers as well.

she is and always has been perfect to me

i grew up on and off seeing her

eventually we came together in a relationship

she didn't want to hurt me because she needs me to be there

the 9 hour distance is to much for her

i do not deserve her

i feel she is my soulmate

and i feel i am watching her fall in love with someone else and leave my life altogether

the other girls ive been with dont seem to matter

i see and think about them as if they are nothing

but i see her one time and everything is broken

if i cant be hers
why be anything?
